entry.title: New: dsh-prompt
entry.summary: Right-side prompt toolbox panel with 24 built-in deep templates plus user-defined ones, accessible via the /prompt slash trigger and a context-aware floating suggestion card; one-click inserts the selected prompt into the composer. Exact install spec: github:featherhunter/dsh-prompt. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
